fact: Lei n.º 9/26, Lei da Cibersegurança, was approved by the National Assembly on 12 August 2026, promulgated on 8 September 2026, revokes Lei 7/17 and enters into force on publication.
title: Lei n.º 9/26 – Lei da Cibersegurança
